definition: having the ability to do something
description: On a rooftop building site at dusk with lit skyscrapers all around, a young woman in a blue and maroon superhero suit with a mask, a flowing cape and tall boots holds up a huge steel beam above her head. She rises from a crouch, pushes the beam up with one arm, then with both hands, and loose bolts fall from it onto the wooden deck. A crane hook hangs nearby, and construction workers in orange hard hats walk calmly across the roof behind her, carrying bags.

taps.phrase: to hold up a steel beam

de.answer: Sie hebt einen riesigen Stahlträger hoch.
de.question: Was macht die Superheldin?

es.answer: Está levantando una enorme viga de acero.
phrases: sostener en alto una viga de acero
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la superheroína?

fr.answer: Elle soulève une énorme poutre en acier.
